method: Every assertion re-runs evaluateSourcePage over the whole inventory under a hypothetical release set. Nothing is estimated and the gate is not modified.

zeroThroughThreeLeavesUnavailable.method: Checked the empty set, and exhaustively every 3-subset formed by dropping each of the four in turn. The route is absent in all of them.

pageCarriesOnlyActiveReleasedClaims.detail: All 5 bound claims hold active releases in that state: 1 already released plus the 4 remainder records. The gate refuses the page outright while any bound claim is unreleased, so a partial page cannot exist.

withdrawingAnyOneMakesItUnavailable.method: Withdrew each of the four in turn; the route disappeared in all four cases.

contributesOneRouteNotFour.note: Four record releases, one source route. The source page is an aggregate, not a per-record page.

notCountedInCanaryResult.note: None of the four is in the five-record canary, so the canary moves the source-page count from 8 to 8.

boundary: A private proof over a prepared release set. No release has occurred and no page described here is live.
